title: poa nemoralis f. vulgaris
intro: Poa nemoralis f. vulgaris, commonly known as rough meadow-grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function, making it a possible treatment for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Poa nemoralis f. vulgaris include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, although further research is needed to fully understand their mechanisms of action.
